news.Title: Prediction: Micron Stock Will Double Before 2028. Here Are 1.7 Trillion Reasons Why.
news.Content:
Prior to the artificial intelligence (AI) revolution, Micron Technology (NASDAQ: MU) was doing its best to claw back from the usual down cycles of the memory market. Late last year the stock started to move higher, and the momentum carried over into 2026. So far this year, Micron stock has ripped 278%, launching the company into the trillion-dollar club.

What changed is simple: AI data centers started devouring high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and high-capacity DRAM faster than suppliers could produce. The question now is whether Micron's rally still has legs. There are 1.7 trillion reasons to think it does.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 14x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

Micron is converting record sales into record profits

Micron's financial performance in fiscal 2026 was absurd on every level. Full-year revenue hit $133 billion, up 256% from the prior year, while earnings per share (EPS) jumped nearly 900% to $74.

During the fourth quarter alone, the company delivered $54.2 billion in sales and $33 in EPS, with gross margin at 87%. Every segment of the business is going full throttle. The core data center unit generated $18 billion during the fourth quarter at a 90% gross margin. Cloud memory added another $16.3 billion at an 83% margin. Mobile and client, plus automotive and embedded, both cleared 84% margins or better.

The mix shift toward HBM and premium DRAM is the engine fueling Micron right now. Those products carry higher prices and better unit economics, so incremental revenue drops straight to the bottom line. Operating cash flow for the year reached nearly $90 billion and while adjusted free cash flow came in at $62 billion – nearly 20x higher than the year prior. With more than 75% of next year's shipments already under contract or allocation, Micron's cash machine does not look like it is about to stall.

MU Revenue (TTM) data by YCharts

Memory supply could be tight until 2028

Micron's CEO Sanjay Mehrotra suggested memory and storage will be tighter throughout fiscal 2027 and 2028 than they are today. The company's COO, Manish Bhatia, explained the structural brakes around memory, discussing how new technology transitions are delivering diminishing bit growth as HBM nodes take a rising share of industry wafers. Bhatia went on to say Micron simply does not have a clear line to "when supply and demand balances."

Story Continues

Wall Street seems to agree with Micron's management. Citi sees the memory shortfall widening through 2031 as DRAM growth accelerates 30% next year and another 35% in 2028. Meanwhile, JPMorgan 's forecast values the memory market at $1.7 trillion by 2028, largely attributable to rising CPU demand alongside memory-intensive GPU systems.

How can Micron stock double?

As of this writing (Oct. 2), Micron stock trades at roughly $1,080 per share. With a forward price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio near 6, this implies the market is modeling somewhere around $176 in earnings for the current fiscal year. Management's guidance for the first quarter points to about $38 in EPS on $61.5 billion of revenue. This implies the earnings run-rate is already there if profit margins hold.

MU PE Ratio (Forward) data by YCharts

Tight supply through 2028 gives Micron room to keep premium prices firm as its product mix continues shifting toward higher-value HBM4 and HBM4E. If earnings simply grow another 20 to 30% on top of the 2027 estimate, you are looking at about $220 in annual EPS by 2028. If I apply even a modest multiple expansion to 10 or 11 times earnings -- still well below historical peaks -- Micron stock could clear $2,000 without needing a massive rerating.

Given today's modest valuation profile multiple, the company's contracted backlog, and the multi-year supply gap, I think Micron stock could reasonably double before 2028 even happens. To me, this level of share price appreciation looks less like wishful thinking and more like a base case scenario so long as the memory shortage simply persists.

news.Title: Not Nvidia. Not AMD. This Networking Stock Is Gaining From Every AI Data Center Built.
news.Content:
Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA) and Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ: AMD) have been some of the top-performing artificial intelligence (AI) stocks due to their chips, but the next winner may be in networking. Data centers require a significant amount of networking cables, and that can position Arista Networks (NYSE: ANET) to outperform both chipmakers during the next year. Here's what makes the stock worth watching.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 14x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

The business model

Arista Networks specializes in Ethernet switches, which transport data in, out, and between server racks. Those racks contain the AI chips that process intense workloads and enable AI products and services like ChatGPT. All of Arista's switches run on its proprietary software.

The neat thing about the software is that it lets Arista's Ethernet switches easily talk to each other and move data more seamlessly across racks and the data center as a whole. Engineers can make changes to thousands of Arista switches simultaneously instead of making changes to individual switches, which was a nightmare in the early 2000s.

Arista sells more switches when customers need to upgrade their data centers to handle more intense workloads. Old ones need to be replaced. Sales also go up when tech giants need to expand their data centers. More chips require more racks, and more racks translate into additional Ethernet switch sales.

It's a huge pain for any data center to switch from Arista to any competitor. That would mean getting rid of all Arista switches and the critical software that links them all together.

Arista's customers have deep pockets

Arista leans heavily on a small number of customers, with Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT) accounting for more than one-quarter of the company's 2025 revenue. Although that type of concentration concerns some investors, Arista's high retention rate and good relationship with hyperscalers are important to keep in mind.

With that issue addressed, it's good to look closer at the customer profile. Microsoft is one of the cloud providers that works with Arista Networks. Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN), Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOG) (NASDAQ: GOOGL), and Meta Platforms (NASDAQ: META) are also customers, and all four of these companies pull in billions of dollars in quarterly profit.

Furthermore, all of these customers have committed to spending more money on artificial intelligence. As their efforts scale, they will need to bolster their AI infrastructure, and that includes buying more of Arista's products.

Story Continues

Those hyperscalers also posted double-digit percentage year-over-year revenue growth rates in their most recent quarters. If growth remains strong, these companies will have no problem pouring more money into Arista's coffers. The broader expansion of AI data centers can also result in new customers that improve diversification.

Revenue growth is trending higher

The AI tailwind has benefited many companies, including Arista, and it's visible in financial results. Arista delivered 38% year-over-year revenue growth in the second quarter. It has an annualized revenue growth rate of 27% during the past decade, so the current growth rate is a big deal.

Arista's $3 billion in revenue also marked a 12% sequential boost. Arista Chief Executive Officer Jayshree Ullal touted the results while explaining that customers see Arista as the "central nervous system" for AI infrastructure.

It's not just this quarter, either. Arista has $5.1 billion in short-term deferred revenue, which will become realized revenue by the end of the year. It also has $1.8 billion in long-term deferred revenue.

Its revenue growth is also coming from all key regions. North American revenue increased by 36% year over year, with strong gains also posted in the EMEA and APAC regions. U.S. hyperscalers are driving most of the AI expenditures, but more traction in other parts of the world can help Arista sustain elevated revenue growth rates even if the North American market slows.

However, that slowdown scenario is unlikely anytime soon. Grand View Research projects a 31% compound annual growth rate (CAGR) for the AI industry through 2033, and Arista should be able to ride that momentum to new all-time highs.

news.Title: If a Stock Market Crash Is Coming, History Says This Is the Best ETF to Buy Right Now
news.Content:
What if I told you that the biggest risk from the next market crash isn't the crash itself? It might be what investors do to their portfolios to try to avoid the crash.

In today's economic environment, there are legitimate reasons for concern. Inflation is high. Oil prices have soared. Interest rates are on the rise. The Shiller CAPE ratio, which measures stock prices relative to inflation-adjusted earnings over the past 10 years, is at its second-highest level of all time.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 14x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

But selling stocks and moving to cash to avoid the decline creates a whole new set of problems. First, you have to be correct in your prediction that a crash is coming and the timing of it. Second, you have to decide when the right time is to get back into stocks (and have the actual discipline to do it).

I'd rather own an ETF that gives me the confidence to remain invested in stocks through the crash.

Your crash strategy should focus on quality

The ETF I'd choose to own if I were trying to anticipate a market crash is the iShares MSCI USA Quality Factor ETF (NYSEMKT: QUAL).

It's built around stocks that demonstrate three fundamental characteristics: higher return on equity (ROE), stable earnings growth, and low financial leverage. That combination creates a portfolio with high balance sheet quality and the flexibility to continue growing the business through tough times.

The interesting part is that the iShares MSCI USA Quality Factor ETF isn't just loaded up with healthcare and consumer staples stocks. Since it focuses on the individual companies, it still has a 39% allocation to tech, including higher exposures to names like Nvidia , Apple , and Microsoft .

That seems counterintuitive to position yourself that way for crash protection. But these are the companies currently delivering some of the biggest revenue and earnings growth. They're among the fund's top 10 holdings for a good reason.

Focus on quality and stay the course

The biggest advantage of investing in quality stocks is that it allows you to maintain your long-term equity allocation while tilting your portfolio toward durability.

You don't have to try to predict a crash and risk damaging your long-term returns if you're wrong. And if a crash doesn't come, you're still invested in equities and enjoy equity market upside.

Story Continues

Bear markets are normal and the price of admission for investing in stocks long term. But over the years and decades, the stock market has recovered each time and eventually reached new highs.

Instead of preparing to get out of stocks, the best course of action is to prepare yourself to stay in them.

news.Title: Why On Semiconductor Is Betting Big on AI Power and What Its $5.7 Billion Bet Means for ON Stock
news.Content:
Earlier this year, On Semiconductor (ON) agreed to buy Synaptics (SYNA), a company known for human interface and sensing chips. Soon after, an unexpected third party provided a competing offer.

When the dust settled, the deal took a different shape. Onsemi's CEO insists it changed in his shareholders' favor.

More News from Barchart

Why It's Time to Load Up on Broadcom Stock Before It Touches $523

NVO vs. LLY: Novo's CEO Says Confidence Is Gone. Lilly Is Winning 7 in 10 New Seniors.

ZS Stock Alert: What to Know as Zscaler Unveils Partnership With IBM

Markets move fast. Keep up by reading our FREE midday Barchart Brief newsletter for exclusive charts, analysis, and headlines.

Why ON Stock is Betting Big on AI Power

To understand why Onsemi wants to acquire Synaptics, you have to go back to the company's investor day on Sept. 16. CEO Hassane El-Khoury opened with a big claim. "It is the era of AI," he told analysts. He explained that AI is running into physical limits on compute, memory, and power. Onsemi wants to own the power piece. "We solve power," he said.

Achyut Shah, president of Onsemi's Power Solutions Group, said the AI data center business will more than double in 2026. He expects it to grow from about $500 million this year to more than $2.5 billion by 2030.

Chief Financial Officer Thad Trent laid out the bigger picture:

Revenue growth: 12% to 14% a year through 2030, reaching just under $11 billion.

Gross margin target: 53%, which Trent called "a milestone," not "a destination."

Free cash flow: More than $3.5 billion by 2030, more than double current levels.

Those projections leave Synaptics out entirely. Trent said Onsemi expects Synaptics to grow more than 15% a year with gross margins above 55%.

Valued at a market cap of $33 billion, ON stock is down 37% from all-time highs. Is the ongoing pullback an opportunity to buy a growth stock at a discount?

New Synaptics Deal Reshapes ON Stock Story

Under the revised agreement, Onsemi will pay $123 per share in cash for Synaptics, according to a joint company statement. That puts the total value at about $5.7 billion, down from roughly $7 billion under the original deal.

The rewrite followed an "unsolicited competing proposal" from a third party, which the companies did not name. The bigger change is how Synaptics shareholders get paid. At the investor day, Gary Mobley of StoneX described the original deal as an "all equity acquisition." Now it is all cash.

In a stock deal, sellers receive shares of the buyer. The value of that payment rises and falls with the buyer's stock price until the deal closes. "We believe the revised merger agreement represents a more financially attractive transaction for our shareholders," El-Khoury said in the statement.

Story Continues

Onsemi expects the deal to add to its adjusted earnings per share immediately after closing. Synaptics' board approved the new terms unanimously after reviewing them with its financial and legal advisers.

"Our Board has been singularly focused on delivering the best outcome for our shareholders, and today's amended agreement reflects that commitment," said Synaptics CEO Rahul Patel. He added that the cash structure offers "value certainty at a meaningful premium as compared to current value."

How Onsemi Plans to Pay for Synaptics

Onsemi will pay for the purchase with cash on hand plus borrowed money. Morgan Stanley (MS) has provided fully committed debt financing. The amended agreement has no closing condition tied to Onsemi's financing, so the deal cannot fall apart if Onsemi fails to line up the money.

The timeline has not changed. Both companies still expect to close by mid-2027. The U.S. Federal Trade Commission has already approved the deal. Regulators in other countries are still reviewing it, and Synaptics shareholders must vote.

What the Deal Means for ON Stock Price

Onsemi had already promised $200 million in annual run-rate synergies within the first 18 months after closing.

Now management sees more upside. According to the statement, Onsemi expects extra gains from revenue synergies and from moving part of Synaptics' production into its own factories. Those benefits should show up after that first 18-month stretch.

Trent hinted at this in September. "We believe over the long term, there's actually more synergies here on the manufacturing side," he said.

The CEO also sees Synaptics as a steady source of cash. He said its businesses "generate strong and predictable cash flows," giving the combined company "a durable funding engine to accelerate its connected compute capabilities."

Shareholders should keep one tradeoff in mind. At the investor day, Trent said Onsemi plans to return 100% of free cash flow to shareholders after investing in the business. The company bought back $4.2 billion of stock between 2023 and 2026 and still has $5.3 billion left on its buyback authorization.

As the deal is paid in cash and partly with debt, some of the capital will now be allocated to fund the acquisition. Still, management believes paying less, in cash, for a faster-growing business is worth it.

Out of 29 analysts covering ON stock, 10 recommend "Strong Buy", two recommend "Moderate Buy", and 17 recommend "Hold". The average ON stock price target is $102, above the current price of $85.

news.Title: Google enters massive 3.6-GW power deal with Constellation Energy
news.Content:
By Laila Kearney

NEW YORK, Oct 6 (Reuters) - Google has contracted for 3,590 megawatts of power from Constellation Energy in the US' largest power grid, with new nuclear ‌energy accounting for about a quarter of that supply, the companies said on Tuesday.

The ‌deal will enable more than $4.3 billion of new investment by Constellation and involves adding capacity at several of the ​power company's nuclear reactors in the Midwest and Mid-Atlantic regions, the companies said.

Major tech companies are racing to secure massive amounts of electricity supplies to power data centers across the US by striking unprecedented deals with the country's power companies.

Over the last two years, Constellation unveiled an agreement to restart ‌its Three Mile Island reactor in ⁠Pennsylvania to serve Microsoft data centers, while Google contracted to restart NextEra Energy's nuclear power plant in Iowa.

In the latest arrangement, Google entered into ⁠a 20-year power purchase agreement for 890 megawatts of electricity from multiple Constellation-owned nuclear power plants, which would be upgraded to produce more electricity from existing reactors.

Electricity from the first of the upgraded ​plants is ​expected to be delivered in 2028, the companies ​said.

Google also entered into a long-term ‌supply agreement for an additional 2,700 megawatts of power from Constellation in PJM. That power is not tied to a specific generation source and serves as long-term revenue certainty for Constellation's operating plants, Google said.

Maryland-based Constellation is the largest US nuclear power plant operator and owns a major fleet of natural-gas-fired power plants.

"We're committed to meeting our growth responsibly by actively investing in ‌clean, reliable power that brings new capacity to our ​nation's grids," said Amanda Peterson Corio, Google's global head ​of energy and power, in a statement.

The ​11 nuclear units expected to be upgraded as part of the arrangement ‌with Google are in Illinois, Pennsylvania, and ​New Jersey, within the ​footprint of the largest US electric grid - PJM Interconnection.

PJM management has proposed requiring data center customers connected to the 13-state grid to either bring their own power or ​face being shut off from grid ‌power remotely in times of peak demand.

The deal between Google and Constellation is ​in response to PJM's "bring your own power" proposal, the companies said.

(Reporting by Laila ​Kearney in New York; Editing by Thomas Derpinghaus)

news.Title: As Tesla Deliveries Rebound, Is It a Better Investment Than SpaceX Stock?
news.Content:
Tesla (NASDAQ: TSLA) stock has had a tough year and a half, but a recent rebound in electric vehicle (EV) deliveries and progress with robotaxis and its Optimus robots have put it in a stronger position. The question is, does this make it a better investment than Elon Musk's other company, Space Exploration Technologies (NASDAQ: SPCX)?

I think it could.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 14x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

What investors know about Tesla

2025 saw Tesla's overall revenue decline by 3% and its automobile revenue fall by 10%. Meanwhile, its adjusted EPS plunged 28%, as operating expenses rose. This year, sales have started to recover, although it has seen a large drop in its highly profitable regulatory credit revenue due to the U.S. removing CAFE standard penalties and looser restrictions in Europe.

The stock, however, got a lift to start the month after reporting strong Q3 delivery numbers that easily beat estimates. For the quarter, Tesla delivered 486,532 vehicles, well ahead of the consensus for 462,000 deliveries. That was its highest total quarterly deliveries for the year, although a decline from the 497,099 it delivered in Q3 of last year.

Tesla's improving trends have been led by Europe, where drivers have started to once again embrace EVs in the wake of high gas prices stemming from the U.S. conflict with Iran. This could be seen in Tesla registration numbers in September, which were up 128.3% in Portugal, 61.9% in France, 38.4% in Sweden, and 24.8% in Spain.

In addition to recovering EV sales, Tesla also introduced its new Cybercab and Semi Truck recently. While the company trails Alphabet 's Waymo in scale at the moment, its Cybercabs cost much less to produce and ultimately could have much better economics in a wide-scale rollout. This is a huge potential market where the surface has barely been scratched. Meanwhile, the electric semi-truck opens up another new market for the company.

Tesla's biggest long-term opportunity, though, may be with its Optimus robot. While there have been some reported snags getting its hands to work, the company has converted an EV facility to manufacture the robots and is hoping to make more than 1,000 a week before year-end, with a longer-term goal of making 20,000 a week. Musk has predicted that Optimus will ultimately become Tesla's largest business at some point.

Story Continues

What investors know about SpaceX

Musk's other business, of course, is SpaceX, which IPO'd earlier this year. Like Tesla, SpaceX has some huge ambitions. While Tesla is looking to shake up the self-driving and robotics industries, SpaceX is looking at far-flung bets on data centers in space, earth-to-earth transport, and asteroid mining.

The company is a leader in the space industry, having developed a reusable rocket. It's now looking to apply that to an even larger rocket, Spaceship, which could help it unlock some of its more aspirational goals. It still faces technical challenges with a larger rocket, but it continues to make solid progress.

In the near- to medium-term, SpaceX's growth is set to be driven by artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure, AI coding, and its Starlink satellite internet service. Starlink is currently its largest business by both revenue and profitability and is performing well, although the growth of its AI data center business will likely far outpace it in revenue in the coming years. Meanwhile, its acquisition of AI coding company Cursor should add a third powerful leg of growth over the next few years.

Why Tesla stock is the better buy

Ultimately, I think SpaceX will acquire Tesla to help bring both of Musk's companies under one roof. It makes a lot of sense not to have him split his time between the two ventures, and it should come with nice synergies. For example, Tesla's solar systems could be used to eventually power orbital data centers, and its robots could help assemble them in space.

Prediction markets are also betting that a merger will happen soon. Polymarket currently puts the odds at 63% that a merger will occur before the end of next year, and Kalshi recently saw the odds rise to 80%. I'd expect SpaceX to acquire Tesla at a decent premium within the next two years, but even if it doesn't, Tesla still has some strong prospects, and it trades at a much cheaper valuation than SpaceX.

As such, I think it is the better growth stock to buy right now.

news.Title: TSMC Is Set Up for a Big October 15. After Record Monthly Sales, 2nm and Margins Will Drive Future Price Action.
news.Content:
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (TSM) reports third-quarter earnings on October 15, with its stock trading near its 52-week high. During its last earnings call, management guided for third-quarter revenue of $44.6 billion to $45.8 billion, about 37% higher than a year earlier at the midpoint. Its revenue is more predictable than most companies, though. TSMC reports sales every month, and July and August already add up to about two-thirds of the quarter's guided total. Its August revenue increased 53% from a year earlier, setting a monthly record. Even if September sales fall about 10% from August's record, the company would still land in the middle of its guided range. That's based on TSMC's own exchange-rate assumption.

In July, TSMC also raised its full-year growth outlook to slightly above 40% and lifted capital spending plans to between $60 billion and $64 billion.

More News from Barchart

Why It's Time to Load Up on Broadcom Stock Before It Touches $523

NVO vs. LLY: Novo's CEO Says Confidence Is Gone. Lilly Is Winning 7 in 10 New Seniors.

ZS Stock Alert: What to Know as Zscaler Unveils Partnership With IBM

Tired of missing midday reversals? The FREE Barchart Brief newsletter keeps you in the know. Sign up now!

Margins Are the Number to Watch

Since revenue holds fewer surprises than usual, the bigger question becomes profitability. TSMC is quickly ramping up its new 2-nanometer chips, and new technology is expensive to produce at first. Management said that ramp would cut gross margin by about 3 to 4 percentage points in the second half. That's why it guided third-quarter gross margin to between 65% and 67%, down from 67.7% in the second quarter.

With strong revenue expected, I believe the stock's reaction will depend on margins instead. A gross margin near the top of the guided range would show TSMC is absorbing those 2-nanometer costs better than planned. A soft margin outlook for the fourth quarter, on the other hand, could weigh on the stock even with record sales. The question for investors is whether the stock prices in that margin risk, so valuation is what I would look at.

TSMC trades above its usual valuation, primarily due to its growth outlook. The forward GAAP P/E of 26.91x sits about 23% above its five-year average of 21.94x. The forward price-to-sales ratio carries an even steeper premium. At 11.96x, it sits 49% above its five-year average of 8.01x. That wider gap on sales shows investors are paying for how much profit TSMC keeps from each dollar of sales. This is another reason why margins matter so much in this report.

Story Continues

The EPS trajectory explains the premium. Analysts expect earnings to grow 59% this year, then over 29% in each of the next two years. On 2027 earnings, the P/E would drop to roughly 21x, slightly below its five-year average. TSMC also holds about $77 billion more cash than debt, enough to cover this year's $60 billion-plus spending plan without relying on borrowing. So I think the valuation overall holds up as long as margins do.

About TSM Stock

Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing is the world's largest semiconductor foundry. Together with its subsidiaries, the company manufactures, packages, tests, and sells integrated circuits and other semiconductor devices. TSMC provides various wafer fabrication processes, such as manufacturing complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor logic, mixed-signal, radio frequency, embedded memory, and others. The company is also involved in providing customer and engineering support services. Founded in 1987, the company is headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

TSM stock has delivered gains of around 60%, while the iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX) returned about 104% over the same period. This shows that despite strong performance, TSMC slightly underperformed the broader semiconductor sector. TSMC started gaining traction following its first-quarter earnings and reached a 52-week high of $479 by the end of June. The trend has continued this year as well, with the stock rising approximately 44% while the index has generated twice the returns compared to the stock.

What Do Analysts Expect for TSM Stock?

Susquehanna analyst Mehdi Hosseini reiterated a Buy rating on TSM and assigned a price target of $600. Similarly, TSM also received a Buy rating from Stifel Nicolaus and a price target of $515. Based on 18 Wall Street analysts, TSM holds a consensus "Strong Buy" rating. Out of those, 15 have a "Strong Buy" rating, two have a "Moderate Buy" rating, and one has a "Hold" rating. The stock's mean price target of $517 reflects a modest upside of 13% from the current share price. The high price target of $650 implies 42% upside from the current levels.

news.Title: Wall St futures rise as yields, oil dip
news.Content:
Oct 6 (Reuters) - US stock index futures rose on Tuesday as Treasury yields dipped from multi-year highs and oil prices retreated, offering investors some relief ahead of the quarterly ‌earnings season.

The tech-heavy Nasdaq closed at a record high on Monday, lifted by heavyweights Nvidia ‌and Microsoft, as investors continued to bet on the AI boom that has pushed stock markets to record highs.

Nvidia rose ​0.7% in premarket trading and was last valued at $5.8 trillion.

The benchmark S&P 500 closed just 0.6% below its mid-August peak on Monday, and a record high for the index would imply the bull market that began in October 2022 remains intact.

Optimism around the AI trade and expectations of strong corporate earnings have helped US stocks ‌outperform global peers over the past ⁠six months despite higher energy prices and a volatile summer for bond markets that fueled concerns about tighter monetary policy.

The yield on 30-year Treasury bonds fell ⁠to 5.626%, having touched a 2002 high of 5.702% a day earlier.

A softer-than-expected payrolls report last week eased expectations around rate hikes this year. Traders now see a 78% chance of the Federal Reserve holding interest rates ​steady ​this month, though a December rate hike remains largely ​priced in, according to the CME Group's ‌FedWatch tool.

Oil prices fell more than 1% on Tuesday, with Brent crude trading at $98.58 as resilient Middle Eastern crude exports and a G7 emergency stockpile release eased supply concerns. [O/R]

'Magnificent Seven' stocks edged higher, with Meta, Tesla and Amazon.com climbing around 0.6% each, while chip stocks such as Intel and Micron Technology were marginally lower.

news.Title: This $15 Trillion Investment Giant Has No Plans to Launch an XRP ETF. That's Why I'm Bearish on XRP Right Now.
news.Content:
Among crypto exchange-traded funds (ETFs), the clear leader is $15 trillion asset management giant BlackRock (NYSE: BLK). This firm offers both the largest spot Bitcoin (CRYPTO: BTC) ETF and the largest spot Ethereum (CRYPTO: ETH) ETF.

XRP (CRYPTO: XRP), which currently ranks as the world's fifth-largest cryptocurrency with a nearly $100 billion market cap, would seem to be a likely candidate for BlackRock's next spot crypto ETF launch.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Yet, BlackRock has never even filed an application with the SEC for a spot XRP ETF. This is despite the fact that seven different spot XRP ETFs already trade in the marketplace. So what's going on here?

The $1.77 billion question

Right now, those seven spot XRP ETFs have $1.77 billion in assets under management. So, there's obviously some demand for them among both retail and institutional investors. And several big names have gotten involved here, including Franklin Templeton (NYSE: BEN), Grayscale, 21Shares, and Bitwise.

Yet, BlackRock continues to ignore XRP. According to the firm, the No. 1 priority for launching a new fund is client demand. And right now, there simply isn't enough client demand to justify creating a new spot XRP ETF.

While $1.77 billion might sound like a big number, it's really not in the context of the firm's Bitcoin ETF, the iShares Bitcoin Trust (NASDAQ: IBIT). This ETF has $67 billion in assets under management. The iShares Ethereum Trust (NASDAQ: ETHA) also dwarfs the combined assets of the seven XRP ETFs, with $10 billion in assets under management.

Just two years ago, before the spot XRP ETFs launched, analysts were predicting that as much as $8 billion might pour into XRP. The amount of money they have attracted -- $1.77 billion -- is just a small fraction of that total. This suggests that analysts badly overstated potential investor demand for XRP.

Should you buy XRP?

Right now, XRP is trading at $1.50. It's hard to see how it could soar much higher unless there is a massive influx of new money. From what BlackRock has told the market about client demand for XRP, that's simply not going to happen anytime soon.

For that reason, I'm not buying XRP right now. It may have a market cap large enough to justify a closer look, but the demand simply isn't there. Until BlackRock starts buying XRP for its clients, I'm looking for better investment opportunities elsewhere.

news.Title: 台股創高外資轉賣 大砍友達8.7萬張、投信提款聯電6萬張
news.Content:
台股今(6)日持續在高檔震盪，盤中最高衝上49,968點，距離5萬點大關僅差約31點，終場上漲110點、收49,822點，再創歷史收盤新高，不過法人卻趁勢逢高調節，三大法人合計賣超207.86億元，其中，外資大砍友達(2409-TW)達8.7萬張，投信則大舉提款聯電(2303-TW)近6萬張，成為內外資今日最大賣超個股。

news.Title: 玉山投信推首檔台股主動式ETF 00413A聚焦關鍵科技
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-06 18:20:04 丁于珊 發佈

看好AI需求持續成長，以及臺灣在全球科技製造供應鏈的重要地位，玉山投信今(6)日推出首檔台股主動式ETF—玉山臺灣關鍵科技主動式ETF(00413A)，結合玉山投信逾30年台股研究實力與主動選股能力，聚焦臺灣關鍵科技投資機會，預計於10月19日至10月23日正式募集，並於11月2日成立、11月11日掛牌交易。

玉山投信董事長張綸宇(圖左二)表示，近年來ETF已成為臺灣資產管理市場的重要成長引擎，而首檔主動式ETF不僅是產品創新的重要里程碑，更象徵玉山投信正式邁向「2.0」的新階段，未來將持續強化投資研究、產品創新與顧客服務三大核心能力。

00413A基金經理人郭明玉表示，AI應用持續從晶片、伺服器等基礎建設向模型及應用層延伸，帶動AI生態系擴大，台灣廠商涵蓋晶圓製造、封裝測試、載板、散熱、零組件及伺服器組裝等領域，在全球AI供應鏈中扮演重要角色。隨著AI技術持續演進，晶片朝向更高效能、更小尺寸發展，也將帶動先進封裝、光通訊、散熱等關鍵技術需求。

00413A預擬產業配置涵蓋半導體、電子零組件、通信網路、電腦及周邊設備等四大關鍵領域，從次產業中篩選具備關鍵地位的科技個股，期望從AI算力到終端應用，一次掌握完整臺灣科技價值鏈。

郭明玉指出，基金透過主動選股掌握科技趨勢各階段的受惠族群，並聚焦臺灣科技業中具備產業核心價值、技術護城河、稀缺資產與戰略地位，且具高進入門檻、難以被複製的企業，同時也將AI商機外溢所帶動的電力、基建、營建等需求，以及航太、醫療保健等相關產業納入評估範圍，致力發掘下一個科技明日之星。

有別於多數ETF採取廣泛分散策略，00413A預計採取30至35檔的集中持股方式，且九成以上配置於關鍵科技，同時保留部分資金布局AI延伸受惠產業，包括電力設備、基礎建設及具產業升級機會的傳統產業。基金亦提供季配息機制，並於基金成立日滿180日(含)後，每年1月、4月、7月及10月底進行評價。

news.Title: 3 Berkshire Hathaway Holdings to Buy While They Sit at Least 15% Below Their Highs
news.Content:
One of the secrets of Berkshire Hathaway (NYSE: BRKA) (NYSE: BRKB) and its success in the stock market has been its focus on value. Whether led by former Chief Executive Officer Warren Buffett or its current leader, Greg Abel, Berkshire has always focused on buying stocks when they are significantly below their intrinsic value.

On top of that, Berkshire's management team has sought companies that have significant advantages over their competitors -- an economic moat -- operating in a mature industry with reliable cash flow.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

That strategy has helped Berkshire Hathaway build an investment portfolio valued at about $350 billion -- and generate returns that averaged 19.7% during the past 60 years, nearly double the S&P 500 's (SNPINDEX: ^GSPC) return.

In today's go-go market, which is focused so heavily on artificial intelligence, machine learning, and other technological advances, it's easy to forget that there are some great value stocks available -- and at comparatively dirt cheap prices. Three such stocks currently in Berkshire's portfolio are American Express (NYSE: AXP), The New York Times Company (NYSE: NYT), and DaVita (NYSE: DVA). Here's the case for buying and holding each of them right now.

Berkshire Hathaway stock No. 1: American Express

Berkshire Hathaway is deeply ingrained in the financial community. Its holdings include a significant stake in publicly traded companies such as Bank of America and Moody's , and it wholly owns several insurance companies, including GEICO. Until last year, it had stakes in American Express, Mastercard , and Visa .

But I've always believed that of the three, American Express is the superior stock. Apparently, Abel feels the same way, as he closed out Berkshire's positions in Mastercard and Visa in the first quarter.

I like American Express because of its market position -- it's geared toward more affluent customers with its gold and platinum card programs, both of which charge hefty annual fees. American Express increased its annual fee for its Platinum card to a whopping $895 earlier this year and offers perks valued at $3,500 to cardholders.

"Our platinum portfolio is now the fastest growing in our U.S. Consumer business; our best-in-class credit performance further strengthened; and we continued to attract a large number of new customers, particularly millennials and Gen Zs who represent greater lifetime value," CEO Stephen Squeri said.

Story Continues

Revenue in the second quarter was $19.6 billion, up 10% from a year ago, and net income of $3.11 billion was up 8%.

American Express is one of Berkshire's largest holdings, with 151.6 million shares, representing 13% of the company's portfolio. However, American Express stock is down 18% so far this year and currently sits 21% off its all-time high. But it's still my favorite financial stock in Berkshire's portfolio.

Berkshire Hathaway stock No. 2: The New York Times Company

We've all heard it: Newspapers are in trouble, and many have shut down -- about 3,500 in the U.S. alone, according to a Poynter study. The industry largely hasn't kept pace with the growth of digital media, losing both advertisers and subscribers.

But The New York Times has been able to buck that trend, embracing digital and capitalizing on its global brand. The company's newspaper had 13.35 million subscribers in the second quarter, with only 550,000 receiving printed copies.

Second-quarter revenue rose 11% from a year earlier to $762.5 million. And even though print advertising continued to decline, falling from $40 million to $35 million in a year, the company recorded a 21% gain in digital ads, bringing total ad revenue to $149 million, up from $134 million a year ago.

The company is a classic example of what Buffett and Abel appreciate: a well-run company with an economic moat that ensures long-term success. The shares are down 8% so far this year and 20% from their all-time highs.

Berkshire Hathaway stock No. 3: DaVita

Interestingly, Berkshire doesn't own many healthcare companies. It took a sizable share in UnitedHealth Group in the second quarter of 2025 before selling it less than a year later. And its Berkshire Hathaway Life company offers health reinsurance but not direct-to-consumer health coverage.

So DaVita holds a unique position in the Berkshire universe. The company focuses on kidney disease and chronic kidney failure, providing dialysis services and care, lab services, and research.

And that's an important field, particularly as the National Kidney Foundation estimates that 35.5 million U.S. adults have kidney disease, and one-third of adults are at risk from the disease.

Second quarter revenue rose to $3.55 billion, up from $3.20 billion a year ago. Net income was $343.2 million, up from $275.2 million in the second quarter of 2025, and diluted earnings per share were $4.02, up from $2.58 per share.

Unlike the other two companies on this list, DaVita is having a very good year, up 58%, but it's still 27% off its all-time highs.

news.Title: What Is the Stock Market? Here's the One Index Fund I'd Buy to Beat It.
news.Content:
What is the stock market? It's one of the most-discussed topics in the news media. It's responsible for the life savings and future retirements of millions of Americans. It's a big reason why many of us go to work every day. But what is it, really?

The stock market is a public worldwide trading network where investors can buy and sell stocks in publicly traded companies. Every day, millions of investors around the world use the stock market to make decisions about how to put trillions of dollars to work.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

As of September 2026, the total market cap of the world's stock markets was about $164.5 trillion, with about 59,500 listed companies. Investing in the stock market can help build the economy by deploying capital to productive companies, innovative entrepreneurs, and growing industries.

When you buy stock in a company, you own a share of that company's future earnings. Investing in the stock market is a way of making a long-term, win-win bet on a brighter future. It's a way of participating in human creativity, collaboration, and prosperity. And most of the time, it's one of the best ways to make money and grow your wealth.

Let's take a closer look at what the stock market is, how it works, and one low-cost index fund that I think is the best buy for the long-term future.

What is the stock market? Start with stock exchanges

Where do people go to buy and sell stocks? You don't have to do it in person anymore, or by calling a stockbroker. Instead, stocks are often traded online through brokerage platforms . But the stock market consists of the stock exchanges in major financial centers like New York, home of the famous New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) on Wall Street.

The Nasdaq is an electronic stock exchange that is more tech-focused. Many of America's most valuable tech companies are listed on Nasdaq rather than the NYSE. Other countries have their own stock exchanges in major cities like London, Tokyo, Toronto, Paris, Shanghai, and Frankfurt.

What are stock indexes?

When people talk about the stock market, they often mean stock market indexes that list and track the performance of stocks. Major stock indexes are in the news headlines and scrolling across financial news TV screens each day. These include:

Story Continues

Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJIA), also known as "the Dow" for short. This is a list of 30 companies considered important and indicative enough of the overall U.S. economy to be worth following.

S&P 500 index (SNPINDEX: ^GSPC): The S&P 500 index lists the top 500 largest publicly traded companies in America, making up about 75%of the total value of the U.S. stock market.

Nasdaq-100 index: The Nasdaq-100 is a tech-heavy index that tracks the 100 largest non-financial companies on the Nasdaq stock exchange. In recent years, the Nasdaq-100 has outperformed the S&P 500, but tech stocks can also be risky and volatile.

When people say, "the stock market is up today" or "the stock market is going through a sell-off," they're often talking about the S&P 500. S&P 500 index funds are an easy, low-cost way for everyday people to invest in the stock market. Some investors buy only these 500 stocks as a large part of their portfolios.

How to beat the stock market

When people say they want to beat the stock market, they usually mean that they want to invest in a way that delivers a stronger return than the S&P 500. Many people try to do this by picking stocks -- buying shares of individual companies they believe will make lots of money in the future.

Here's the problem with trying to beat the stock market: It's really hard. Over the past 98 years, the S&P 500 has delivered average annual returns of 10%. Many professional money managers can't do better than that, at least not for long. They might pick a portfolio of winning stocks today, or they might try to chase trends, only to find out that in the next three to five years, their overhyped stocks go into a big downturn while the "boring" S&P 500 powers on ahead.

One index fund to "beat the stock market": VTI

That said, if I had to pick one index fund to outperform the S&P 500, I would choose the Vanguard Morningstar Total Stock Market ETF (NYSEMKT: VTI). This is a low-cost index fund that holds an impressively diversified portfolio of 3,507 U.S. stocks. When you buy VTI, you get the 500 largest companies of the S&P 500, along with thousands of other stocks.

The Vanguard Morningstar Total Stock Market ETF has delivered average annual returns of 14.7% over the past 10 years, and about 12.6% over the past five years. If you keep investing consistently and hold onto your stocks for the long run, these returns will be more than enough to build significant wealth.

I don't know if VTI will beat the S&P 500 in 2027, or next year, or the year after that. But I'm a long-term investor, so I don't want to limit myself "only" to the 500 largest stocks. I want small-cap stocks (the up-and-coming companies of the future). I want mid-cap stocks (mid-sized companies with a balance of risk and reward). I want growth stocks and value stocks.

VTI gives me all of that in one index fund. By owning the entire U.S. stock market, it might well beat the S&P 500 over the long run.

news.Title: Why Citi now thinks AMD stock could rip another 25% because of Meta Muse
news.Content:
AMD shares have more record highs in their future, says Citi.

Citi analyst Atif Malik raised his price target on AMD to $800 from $575 on Tuesday. Shares rose 1% in premarket trading and look set to open at another record high.

"Following the release of Meta ( META ) Muse and our subsequent CPU TAM raise, we are raising estimates on AMD given our belief that AMD will be the primary beneficiary of the CPU renaissance and our belief that Meta is one of the largest customers of AMD's server business," Malik said.

Malik also struck a more bullish tone on the future size of the CPU market.

"We update our CPU model post the launch of Muse, Meta's personal AI agent. Fundamentally, we view agentic AI as a potential orders-of-magnitude driver of compute demand relative to traditional chatbots. We believe the CPU TAM [total addressable market] expands from $29 billion in 2025 to $300 billion in 2030, or a 60% CAGR. We still expect AMD to be the key beneficiary of the CPU renaissance and Intel as a secondary beneficiary," Malik added.

AMD has had quite a run of bullish catalysts in recent months.

Just two weeks ago, AMD signed an agreement to acquire World Labs , a San Francisco-based AI model lab that focuses on software for 3D environments. The purchase price: a cool $8.2 billion. The transaction is expected to close by the end of 2026.

World Labs was founded in 2024 and is led by Dr. Fei-Fei Li, a leading AI researcher known in tech circles as the "Godmother of AI." She was once chief scientist at Google ( GOOG ) Cloud.

AMD beat Wall Street expectations across the board for the second quarter in early August, posting record non-GAAP earnings per share of $1.66 versus consensus estimates of $1.61. Total revenue surged 50% year over year to a record $11.5 billion, clearing analyst projections of approximately $11.34 billion.

The strong top- and bottom-line performance was fueled by the company's Data Center segment. Revenue more than doubled year over year to $6.7 billion on robust demand for EPYC server CPUs and Instinct AI accelerators.

AMD projected second-half 2026 server CPU revenue to grow 80% year over year and 70% in 2027. It expects data center revenue to more than double in 2027, with AI graphics processing unit (GPU) revenue growing well over 100%.

"The CPU renaissance is playing out," said EvercoreISI analyst Mark Lipacis.

AMD also unveiled its next-generation AI chips, headlined by the Instinct MI450 Series GPUs and the 6th Gen EPYC Venice CPUs. The new chips are designed to power AMD's new Helios rack-scale AI systems , which combine GPUs, CPUs, networking, and software into an integrated platform for training and running large AI models.

news.Title: 國泰投信：台股有底氣「過五關斬六將」
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-06 18:05:51 丁于珊 發佈

進入2026年第4季，全球市場一方面面臨油價、通膨及升息壓力，另一方面AI產業基本面仍展現強勁成長動能，而在AI發展帶動下，台股2026年漲幅已約七成，加權指數今(6)日盤中更衝上 49,968.92 點，逼近5萬點大關。國泰資產管理暨國泰世華銀行首席經濟學家林啟超(附圖右三)表示，2027年台灣上市櫃企業稅後盈餘有望超過10兆元，總市值有機會突破200兆元，台股非常有底氣可「過五關斬六將」。

展望第4季，國泰投信表示，第4季全球投資環境將呈現「總經有逆風、產業有亮點」景況，美歐日央行仍有升息壓力，美國10年期公債殖利率可能維持高檔，資金成本上升恐加大股市震盪。然而，AI資本支出持續擴張，企業獲利成長仍為科技股提供基本面支撐。台股受惠全球AI供應鏈需求及出口暢旺，美股則由大型科技及半導體企業引領獲利成長，整體來看，第4季持續關注具實質獲利支撐的科技產業，投資布局以「台美科技雙主線」掌握AI長線成長趨勢。

國泰資產管理暨國泰世華銀行首席經濟學家林啟超表示，戰事推升油價並重新點燃全球通膨疑慮，美國、歐洲及日本央行第4季持續升息機率仍高；目前債市利率亦已逐步反映未來一年約3碼的升息預期，預估至年底美國10年期公債殖利率偏向5%高檔震盪，美元指數則在100上下，而油價將是後續重要驅動因素。 展望全年，林啟超預估，台灣出口挑戰9,000億美元，2026年經濟成長率上看12%。

在美股表現方面，國泰費城半導體（00830）經理人李翰林(附圖左一)指出，美股主要指數之一的費城半導體指數，2026年、2027年兩年的EPS成長率分別達143.7%及45.8%，高於那斯達克100指數及標普500指數；同時，費半指數主要成分股的相對估值較2022年11月底ChatGPT問世時已大幅降低，主要來自預期EPS成長率大幅提高，顯示產業仍有獲利成長支撐。

針對台股，國泰投信產品策略發展處協理游日傑(附圖右一)表示，長線上AI發展仍是台股重要投資主線，隨著AI模型規模及應用範圍持續擴張，從GPU、先進製程、先進封裝、高速傳輸，到雲端資料中心與終端應用，所需資本支出與技術門檻同步墊高，半導體及科技板塊「大者恆大」趨勢更加鮮明，具備技術領先、規模經濟及完整客戶基礎的產業龍頭，更有機會承接AI浪潮帶來的龐大商機。

游日傑進一步說明，過去投資AI供應鏈主要觀察台積電(2330)、輝達等指標企業，以及伺服器廠商訂單與資本支出，但隨著AI應用持續擴散，市場關注焦點將延伸至電腦、網通、CPU、高速傳輸等領域，尤其代理型AI可透過虛擬伺服器及網頁執行任務，將增加長時間運算的功耗需求，以及資料交換、高速傳輸等需求，同時消費性電子相關CPU也有機會受惠。

游日傑指出，AI產業的訂單能見度仍高，從主要科技大廠剩餘履約義務（RPO）來看，相關數據維持在高檔，且預期2027年至2029年每年仍有約4000-5000億美元的產品確定交付，將為台股提供基本動能。

林啟超並提到，台灣上市櫃企業2026年稅後盈餘預估可達7.9兆元，2027年可望超過10兆元，若以20-21倍本益比估算，2027年台灣上市櫃總市值可望突破200兆元，台股非常有底氣可「過五關斬六將」。游日傑也表示，台股2026年漲幅已約7成，但主要是反應營收，評價面還未真正反應，若台股評價面上調，未來仍有上漲空間。

而對於2026年第4季ETF配置建議，國泰投信表示，高利率環境雖可能放大市場波動，但全球AI競賽已進入「比技術、比資本、比規模」新階段，具競爭優勢的科技龍頭值得持續關注。

news.Title: Nvidia vs. Broadcom: Which AI Chip Stock Is the Better Buy Now?
news.Content: NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ: NVDA ) and Broadcom Inc. (NASDAQ: AVGO ) offer two different claims on the AI computing budget. Nvidia sells a broad GPU platform supported by software and integrated systems. Broadcom helps customers build custom accelerators and supplies networking alongside a substantial software business. An investor choosing between them needs to decide which company can retain more cash as customers seek cheaper computing. At the October 5 close, their trailing cash-flow valuations were close enough that the business differences matter more than a small discount. My preference is Nvidia, provided its software advantage continues to protect margins and ...
news.AI_Summary:
• Nvidia and Broadcom are key players in the AI chip market, offering distinct strategies: Nvidia with its GPU platform and software, and Broadcom with custom accelerators and networking.
• Nvidia reported Q3 revenue of $96.2 billion, up 106% YoY, with a 75% GAAP gross margin, driven by its software advantage (CUDA) and platform flexibility.
• Broadcom reported Q3 revenue of $29.6 billion, up 86% YoY, with AI semiconductor revenue up 221% to $16.7 billion and a 46% free cash flow margin.
• The choice between Nvidia and Broadcom hinges on whether custom chips gain share against Nvidia's platform and if financing support remains contained.

news.Title: 台股上漲有底氣 投信：明年企業獲利破10兆
news.Content:
[ 非凡新聞 ]記者黃友柔,攝影林秋強

台股距離50000點，就差臨門一腳，雖然總經面有逆風，不過產業面也有亮點！隨著AI資本支出持續擴張，國泰投信預期，企業獲利為科技股提供基本面支撐，今年台股企業獲利將達7.9兆，明年挑戰10兆元。但是也不能忽視，國際油價仍維持高檔，推升市場對升息的預期，學者預估除了12月再升息，明年上半年也還有1到2碼的升息空間。

民眾：「AI好的話，我認為對台股是一個不錯的利多。」

民眾：「趨勢一直跟著AI走，後續應該就是一定會有到五萬點。」

台股50000近關情怯，不過股民對第四季還是信心滿滿，因為指數上漲確實真有底氣。

國泰資產管理／國泰世華銀行首席經濟學家 林啟超：「目前比較大的驅動因子還是企業的獲利，今年的話目前來看可能會超過7.8兆元，成長大概73%，明年我想會是第一次突破十兆元，所以這個是台股或者是這些以半導體為主的股市最大的一個支撐。」

AI軍備競賽帶動台股企業獲利大幅成長，所以儘管今年不少股票價格都已經來到相對高點，但從產業發展來看，專家還是看好散熱、PCB、CCL等相關零組件的升級趨勢。

國泰投信基金國內股票投資部主管 黃維泰：「即便可能已經反映了一年多，我們覺得在明、後年還是可以看到很好的反應出現的成績出來1013，另外一塊可能就是我們認為光通，當你的傳輸速度從800G到1.6T，甚至到後年可能會想像到3.2T之下，你的一些物理上的限制勢必就會走到光的這個傳輸的話，所以光通很多公司可能都還沒有展現到他業績上面去。」

不過當然市場也並非一帆風順，除了美國期中選舉的不確定性，聯準會升息以及對匯率的影響仍舊是一大變數。

國泰資產管理／國泰世華銀行首席經濟學家 林啟超：「目前來看的話12月升完息之後，明年的上半年應該還是有升息的狀況，當然這要取決於整個油價，因為油價到今天還是在90塊上下，相較於去年的同期，今年的油價大概已經上漲超過25%，所以這是短期間之內，聯準會他很難停止升息的主要原因。」

AI添柴火、升息踩剎車，50000何時達陣就看多空角力如何分出勝負。（記者黃友柔、林秋強／台北採訪報導）

news.Title: 台股逼近5萬點創高　外資轉賣新台幣小升0.7分
news.Content:
（中央社記者潘姿羽台北2026年10月6日電）美股主要指數全數收漲，激勵台股繼續衝鋒，不過外資終止連4買，午後轉向匯出，新台幣兌美元走勢先升後貶，尾盤翻揚，終場收在31.781元，小升0.7分，台北及元太外匯市場總成交金額23.37億美元。

台股多頭氣焰高漲，劍指5萬點大關，儘管今天近關情怯，盤中仍創歷史新高49968.92點，終場加權指數上漲110.51點，收49822.55點，同步締造新猷。

外資今天終止連4買，轉為賣超66.57億元，台股雖強勢表態，卻拉不動新台幣匯率。

新台幣兌美元今天以31.76元開盤，在熱錢流入、台股攻高兩大因素助攻下，迅速升抵盤中最高31.699元，不過升幅逐步收斂，並於午後翻貶，最低觸及31.823元，央行在尾盤略作調節，終場收在31.781元，匯價連5升。

外匯交易員指出，雖然台股收紅，但短線獲利了結賣壓湧現，午後外資轉向匯出，加上美元指數仍在高位，抑制新台幣走勢，因而出現台股持續創高、新台幣卻升不動的現象；近日新台幣多靠央行尾盤調節，得以小幅收升。

外匯交易員進一步指出，10月以來，新台幣匯價多於31.7至31.8元價位震盪，主要是外資量能沒有進一步放大，難以引領新台幣突破區間，下方有進口商美元買盤承接，上方有出口商等待匯價回貶、伺機拋匯，但兩方追價意願都不高，新台幣陷入窄幅波動。

展望新台幣走勢，外匯交易員認為，如果台股能夠帶量上攻，成功挑戰5萬點，有利吸引熱錢湧入，支撐新台幣走勢；此外，目前市場普遍認為美國聯準會10月不升息、12月升息1次，後續美國經濟數據是否支持此看法相當關鍵，也將牽動股匯市表現。

news.Title: 最高49968點! 攻5萬差一步 收49822續寫歷史
news.Content:
[ 非凡新聞 ]記者謝旻蓁,攝影詹明樺

台股周二蓄勢待發挑戰5萬點大關，在台積電創新天價來到2590元新天價激勵下，早盤台股一度站上49968點，創下盤中新高紀錄，隨後台積電股價拉回，指數也由紅翻黑，尾盤在PCB、伺服器代工、光學股等族群衝高激勵下，指數終場上漲110點，收在49822點，創收盤新高，成交量達1.02兆元。三大法人合計賣超台股207億元，其中外資賣超66億元，投信賣超158億元，僅自營商買超17億元。

民眾：「（台積電）3千有機會吧！」

民眾：「（台積電）如果要擺個一兩年，5千應該有吧，有錢就買啊！」

最近天氣轉涼，但是股民們投資熱忱反而越燒越旺，因為台股距離5萬點里程碑，真的只差最後一步，週二最高來到49968點，刷新盤中新高紀錄，可惜追價力道不足，指數一度由紅翻黑，隨後在南亞帶頭衝上300元創盤中歷史新高後，加權指數又回到平盤附近震盪。

台新投顧總經理 黃文清：「一開高就出現一些震盪的格局，當然最主要還是因為在這個過程當中，這個量的放大基本上還要更多的成交量來推升，尤其權值類股這邊外資如果能夠回流買超，其實是對於這個盤勢真正突破5萬點，其實相對就有幫助。」

觀察盤面族群走勢，大型電子權值股漲跌互見，台積電週二續創新天價2590元，隨後獲利了解賣壓出籠，鴻海單月營收破兆，激勵股價走揚，聯發科則是跌近半根停板。

PCB概念股買盤點火，受惠於外資調高目標價至萬元以上，千金股台光電站上6千元大關，伺服器代工族群輪番表態，資金也同步轉進資安、金融等族群，市場看好在第四季旺季效應發酵下，千金股家數有望持續攀升，最快10月底前挑戰60千金盛況。

台新投顧總經理 黃文清：「10月份的觀察重點在於台積電的法說，在10月中也就是我們放國慶假日之後，市場還是給予高度期待，月底美國四大CSP的這些財報、法說，目前看起來都還是審慎樂觀，走到年底又有市場對於明年度展望的一個樂觀的預期，換句話說10月份漲、11月休息、12月再來期待明年的年度展望。」

同時專家也提醒，台股逼近5萬點高檔關卡，市場難免近關情怯，加上美債殖利率與油價仍處於上行趨勢，投資人還是要留意後續潛在的震盪風險。（記者 謝旻蓁、詹明樺／台北採訪報導）

news.Title: 台股叩關5萬「別亂踩煞車」！專家點名這2檔：把握大行情
news.Content:
台股近期氣勢強勁，指數持續向5萬點大關靠攏，投資人究竟該趁高停利，還是繼續抱牢？財經作家施昇輝今（6）日在臉書《樂活分享人生》發文表示，台股期貨前一日盤中一度觸及5萬點，大盤也有機會挑戰甚至突破5萬點。他認為，目前正值可以加速累積財富的行情，「千萬不要亂踩煞車」，並點名一般投資人可透過「2檔ETF」掌握台股長線行情。

施昇輝喊別急著踩煞車 點名0050、0056

施昇輝表示，面對台股持續創高，投資人不應因為指數來到高檔，就急著獲利了結或大幅降低持股。他寫道：「在這個可以加速累積個人財富的路上，千萬不要亂踩煞車」。他認為，對一般投資人而言，與其頻繁預測短線漲跌，不如透過熟悉的ETF參與市場，並直接點名元大台灣50（0050）及元大高股息（0056）。

他更以棒球比賽比喻目前行情，認為當比賽處於「滿壘、無人出局」的大好得分局面時，如果只採取犧牲觸擊、只求拿下一分，反而可能錯失一次大量得分的機會。施昇輝認為，人生未必還能遇到像近一、兩年這樣的市場行情，因此應思考如何把握長期趨勢。

網友支持長抱 有人卻選擇「過5萬就空」

貼文曝光後，也引發網友熱烈討論。部分長期投資者認同施昇輝的看法，認為不用過度預測短期指數漲跌，只要相信長期市場趨勢，也有人分享自己調整投資部位、增加0050、0056及其他台股ETF後，投資成果有所改善。

不過，留言區也出現不同聲音，有人直喊「過5萬就空」，也有人翻出施昇輝過去曾提出的市場觀點進行討論。另有網友強調，自己更重視長期存股與投資過程中的睡眠品質，「吃得好、睡得著最重要」，甚至認為市場下跌反而能提供持續加碼的機會。

（封面圖／東森新聞）

news.Title: 外資終結連4買　加碼主動ETF調節科技股
news.Content:
（中央社記者鍾榮峰台北2026年10月6日電）台股今天上漲110點收49822點，距5萬點大關僅一步之遙，三大法人合計賣超新台幣207.86億元，其中自營商買超17.21億元，投信賣超158.5億元連2賣，外資及陸資賣超66.57億元，終結連4買。外資加碼主動型ETF，調節友達、鴻海和台積電。

在台指期淨部位，三大法人淨空單增加1178口至5193口，其中外資淨空單增加2513口至7萬9517口。

觀察外資買賣超個股動向，根據台灣證券交易所統計，外資加碼超過萬張的股票包括主動統一升級50（00403A）、主動統一台股增長（00981A）、華通、台化、兆豐金、主動統一全球創新（00988A）等。

相較之下，外資減碼友達8.7萬張位居第1，調節復華富時不動產（00712）約2.04萬張，賣超鴻海1.99萬張，減碼逾萬張的股票包括元大台灣50 (0050) 、主動中信台灣收益（00406A）、主動群益科技創新（00992A）、力積電、群益臺灣加權正2（00685L）等。外資也調節台積電1672張。

兆豐國際投顧董事長留政鈺接受記者電訪指出，美國就業數據欠佳減輕升息疑慮，資金回流到科技股，目前美國10年期公債殖利率維持高檔，但市場評估產業成長性優於升息因素，後續觀察AI產業在第4季表現。

留政鈺表示，台股5萬點應該只是「心理關卡」，靜待後續資金加碼進場，帶動台股繼續上攻。

台新台灣中小主動式ETF基金經理人沈建宏指出，AI投資長期趨勢不變，市場預估台股上市櫃公司獲利年增率，到2027年維持兩位數百分比成長，預期台股中小利基股獲利成長強勁，將扮演台股挑戰新高的火車頭。

news.Title: 蘇姿丰快閃來台要產能! 赴新竹台積電.曝增加投資台廠供應鏈
news.Content: 財經中心／楊思敏、吳志恆、陳威余、謝漢諹　台北報導 超微執行長蘇姿丰今年二度訪台，一下飛機就與四家台廠供應鏈會面，下午又直奔新竹台積電，就是為了確保產能，跟得上市場需求。上次來台，超微宣布投資台灣供應鏈100億美元，蘇姿丰表示，金額會持續增加。 半導體女王、超微執行長蘇姿丰早上一抵台，展開一連串閉門會議，台廠包含華碩董事長施崇棠和鴻海董事長劉揚偉，都現身下榻飯店。 超微執行長蘇姿丰：「特別是現在市場變化快速，與主要供應商非常緊密合作，對我們來說是重要的，我們在2027年，將大幅增加供給，但我們當然需要更多，這也是我來到台灣的原因。」 來台要產能，蘇姿丰見了宏碁、華碩、鴻海和廣達，下午直奔新竹台積電會面。至於市場傳聞，台積電在評估德州設廠，是否有徵詢超微意見，她沒正面回應。 蘇姿丰一早抵達台北後，展開一連串高層閉門會議。（圖／民視財經網） 超微執行長蘇姿丰：「（台積電）在美國亞利桑那的廠，對我們來說非常的好，我們期待全球有更多的產能，滿足現在的高需求，過去我們是以，1年、2年來規劃（產能），如今我們要一起規劃，未來的3、4、5年。」 超微的AI機架平台Helios第三季出貨，將持續放量，從晶圓代工、封測到載板，都仰賴台廠產能，但她也被問到會擔心台海情勢嗎。 超微執行長蘇姿丰：「我們鼓勵所有夥伴，在地理上有更多元，但毫無疑問，台灣對於半導體供應鏈來說，絕對關鍵，對超微來說也非常非常關鍵。」 蘇姿丰與台廠供應鏈會面，確保產能。（圖／民視財經網） 蘇姿丰強調台灣重要性，也可以從五月訪台時，宣布投資供應鏈100億美元時，看的出來。

news.Title: 玉山投信推出首檔台股主動式ETF  00413A瞄準臺灣關鍵科技
news.Content:
看好AI需求持續成長，以及臺灣在全球科技製造供應鏈的重要地位，今(6)日玉山投信推出首檔台股主動式ETF—玉山臺灣關鍵科技主動式ETF（本基金之配息來源可能為收益平準金），證券代號00413A，結合玉山投信逾30年台股研究實力與主動選股能力，聚焦臺灣關鍵科技投資機會，預計於10月19日至10月23日正式募集，並於11月2日成立、11月11日掛牌交易。

玉山投信董事長張綸宇表示，近年來ETF已成為臺灣資產管理市場的重要成長引擎，而首檔主動式ETF不僅是產品創新的重要里程碑，更象徵玉山投信正式邁向「2.0」的新階段，未來將持續強化投資研究、產品創新與顧客服務三大核心能力。玉山投信總經理梅以德則指出，玉山投信台股基金品牌歷史超過30年，具備完整的產品線與績效成果，長期服務對象涵蓋共同基金、政府四大基金(註1)、壽險及大型機構法人，並為全臺唯一私校退撫基金顧問機構，在主動式台股投資領域擁有深厚基礎，此次推出主動式台股ETF，將同步發揮研究團隊的專業實力。

00413A預擬產業配置涵蓋半導體、電子零組件、通信網路、電腦及周邊設備等四大關鍵領域，從次產業中篩選具備關鍵地位的科技個股，期望從AI算力到終端應用，一次掌握完整臺灣科技價值鏈。基金並運用「ACE策略」進行選股，透過主動選股掌握科技趨勢各階段的受惠族群，並聚焦臺灣科技業中具備產業核心價值、技術護城河、稀缺資產與戰略地位，且具高進入門檻、難以被複製的企業，同時也將AI商機外溢所帶動的電力、基建、營建等需求，以及航太、醫療保健等相關產業納入評估範圍，致力發掘下一個科技明日之星。

有別於多數ETF採取廣泛分散策略，00413A預計採取30至35檔的集中持股方式，且九成以上配置於關鍵科技，同時保留部分資金布局AI延伸受惠產業，包括電力設備、基礎建設及具產業升級機會的傳統產業。基金亦提供季配息機制，並於基金成立日滿180日(含)後，每年1月、4月、7月及10月底進行評價。

根據玉山臺灣關鍵科技主動式ETF團隊統計，第四季向來是臺灣科技股相對具表現機會的期間，而10月更是良好的佈局時點。從過去20年歷史數據來看(註2)，若於每年10月底進場投資臺灣科技股指數，無論持有1個月、3個月、6個月或1年，平均報酬表現均優於大盤，且持有時間越長，優勢越明顯，顯示第四季是科技股展望行情逐步發酵的重要階段。

展望今年市場，玉山投信指出，整體仍具備「景氣、獲利、時機」三大利多。首先，AI需求持續推升臺灣外銷訂單成長，經濟成長率有機會挑戰雙位數；其次，美國大型雲端服務業者（CSP）持續擴大AI資本支出，可望帶動台股科技供應鏈營收與獲利成長；最後，AI 產業已自晶片、伺服器擴散至光通訊、高速傳輸、測試設備等新受惠族群，產業輪動機會持續浮現。00413A擬任經理人郭明玉表示，在AI長線趨勢不變下，第四季不僅是企業展望與資金布局的重要時間點，加上今年仍有美國利率政策變動、選舉及地緣政治等變數，建議投資人透過主動式ETF由專業團隊選股，提前掌握下一波成長機會的關鍵時機。

資料來源：Bloomberg，玉山投信整理，2026/09。(註1)政府四大基金為勞工退休基金、勞工保險基金、公務人員退休撫卹基金與郵政儲金的統稱。(註2)計算期間為2006/01/01~2026/07/31 ， 臺灣科技類股以電子類指數為例，均以總報酬計算。

玉山投信獨立經營管理。

news.Title: Warren Buffett Says Buy This Vanguard Index Fund -- It Could Turn $400 Per Month Into $820,000
news.Content: Under Warren Buffett, Berkshire Hathaway stock returned 19.7% annually between 1965 and 2025, nearly doubling the 10.5% annual return in the S&P 500 (SNPINDEX:^GSPC). That makes Buffett a great source of inspiration, and he consistently recommended an S&P 500 index throughout his career. "In my view, for most people, the best thing to do is to own the S&P 500 index fund," Buffett said at Berkshire Hathaway's shareholder meeting ...
news.AI_Summary:
• Warren Buffett advocates for investing in an S&P 500 index fund, like the Vanguard S&P 500 ETF (VOO), for most investors.
• The S&P 500 index represents 500 large U.S. companies across all sectors and is considered a strong barometer of the U.S. stock market.
• Top holdings in the Vanguard S&P 500 ETF include Nvidia (8.1%), Apple (7%), and Microsoft (5.7%), indicating significant exposure to tech giants.
• Buffett's rationale includes the difficulty of beating the index, the strength of the U.S. economy, and the low expense ratio (0.03%) of funds like VOO.
• Historically, the S&P 500 has delivered strong returns (10.2% annually over 30 years), with projections suggesting $400 monthly could reach $820,000 in three decades.
news.Keywords: index fund, S&P 500, diversification, long-term investing, expense ratio, market barometer

news.Title: 台股近5萬點選股超難！類股輪動太快　專家點名「這檔ETF」三要素通吃
news.Content:
台股今（6）日強勢上漲110.51點，收在49,822.55點，逼近5萬點大關，但類股快速輪動讓不少投資人直呼「追到腳抽筋」。面對市場風格多變、選股難度暴增，投資人逐漸從主動選股轉向策略型ETF。 財經專家葉育碩 指出，在兼顧資產成長與現金流的需求下，主打「成長、動能、配息」三大要素的玉山市值動能50（009803）展現出獨特優勢，成為市場關注的交投焦點。

【年化配息率上看16.64% 專家比喻：極品成熟男人】

財經專家葉育碩表示，經歷下半年市場震盪，投資人發現單靠單一風格很難吃遍行情，連ETF也開始「內卷」。以玉山市值動能50（009803）為例，今年以來含息報酬高達約8成，最新一季配息0.90元，換算年化配息率約16.64%。葉育碩風趣形容，這樣的績效就像成熟男人，「既把事業做好，還會做家事，也知道要拿錢回家」，同時兼具了成長性與現金流。

【AI新平台量產進場 一包掌握先進封裝到資料中心】

葉育碩強調，看配息不能只看數字，關鍵在於選股邏輯。009803透過市值、成長、價值、品質、動能等五大因子篩選大型企業。隨著輝達（Nvidia）新一代Vera Rubin平台進入量產，AI需求一路延伸至封裝、伺服器、網通與電源裝備。009803成分股中包含台積電（2330）、聯發科（2454）、鴻海（2317）、台達電（2308）、智邦（2345）、奇鋐（3017）、欣興（3037）、南電（8046）、景碩（3189）、台光電（2383）、高力（8996）、川湖（2059）等AI供應鏈，合計權重近50%，猶如吃自助餐般一次涵蓋完整AI產業鏈。

【兼顧成長與現金流 回歸個人投資需求】

輔以市場新聞與理財專家觀點驗證，在台股高檔震盪之際，009803展現出優於傳統高股息ETF的資本利得爆發力。葉育碩總結，選擇這類 「成長＋動能＋配息」 的市值型ETF，最核心的問題仍是回歸個人需求：若希望在維持穩定現金流之餘，同時保留資產資本利得的成長空間，009803確實值得列入投資人的長期觀察清單中。

不過，ETF仍然有市場波動風險，投資人也應留意009803對大型權值股及AI供應鏈的曝險程度，不能只因為近期績效或配息亮眼就追高。

news.Title: Nvidia, Palantir, and Alphabet Are Sending Shockwaves Through Wall Street With This $17.5 Billion Warning
news.Content: Three decades ago, the advent and proliferation of the internet lit a fire under Wall Street's major indexes. Today, the artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure build-out is stoking the same enthusiasm and fueling a multitrillion-dollar addressable opportunity. Though dozens of tech-driven companies are benefiting from the AI revolution, Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA), Palantir Technologies (NASDAQ:PLTR), and Google parent Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL)(NASDAQ:GOOG) are at ...
news.AI_Summary:
• Nvidia, Palantir, and Alphabet are identified as leaders in the AI infrastructure and applications space, facing a potential 'bubble-bursting' event.
• Insiders at these three companies have engaged in significant net-selling activity over the past five years, totaling approximately $17.5 billion.
• Nvidia insiders sold over $6.86 billion, Palantir over $6.51 billion, and Alphabet over $4.15 billion in net stock sales.
• Insider purchases have been minimal, raising questions about their expectation of future share-price appreciation, particularly for Palantir with its high P/S ratio.
• While tax-related selling is common, the lack of substantial insider buying suggests potential valuation concerns or a belief that the pace of AI optimization might be overestimated.
news.Keywords: AI, insider selling, valuation, P/S ratio, market bubble, capital allocation

news.Title: Will Micron Do a Stock Split Before the End of 2026?
news.Content: When stocks trade at high prices, there is a potential for a stock split. Micron Technology (NASDAQ:MU) has a share price of over $1,000 and has risen to more than $1,200 earlier this year. It could conceivably do a 10-for-1 split and still be priced at over $100, ...
news.AI_Summary:
• Micron Technology (MU) has experienced significant stock price appreciation, rising over 1,400% in five years, with its share price exceeding $1,200.
• Despite the high share price, a stock split is considered unlikely due to potential volatility and management's focus on share price stability.
• A stock split would not change the investor's overall investment value, only the number of shares and the price per share.
• Micron's stock has surged approximately 270% year-to-date, reaching a valuation of about $1.2 trillion.
• The article suggests holding off on buying Micron stock due to potential downside risk if the memory shortage ends sooner than expected and the stock's recent rapid ascent.
news.Keywords: stock split, share price volatility, memory shortage, valuation, downside risk, market sentiment

news.Title: 5萬點前法人先下車！台股守住110點漲勢再刷新高 台塑集團、台光電領CCL強攻救場｜Yahoo財經掃描
news.Content:
台積攜題材股撐場，台股漲110點再創高！今(6)日加權指數終場上漲110.51點、漲幅0.22%，收49,822.55點，成交金額9,779.96億元；盤中最高衝上49,968.92點，距五萬點僅約31點，隨後獲利了結賣壓出籠、一度翻黑，尾盤仍守住漲勢。櫃買指數下跌0.37%，電子指數小漲0.05%，金融指數上揚1.29%，盤面呈現高檔震盪、類股輪動格局。

台積電(2330)盤中登上2590元新天價，終場上漲10元、收2585元，漲幅0.39%，再寫收盤紀錄。伺服器需求與漲價題材帶旺銅箔基板族群，台光電(2383)強漲5.18%，聯茂(6213)上漲4.79%；台塑集團股同步撐場，南亞(1303)走揚2.45%。封測股矽格(6257)亮燈漲停，力成(6239)、欣銓(3264)也表現強勢；不過聯發科(2454)下跌4.74%、失守5000元，友達(2409)、聯電(2303)持續走弱，光通訊股聯亞(3081)、光聖(6442)亦拉回，強弱個股各有表現。

亞洲市場漲跌互見，日經指數上漲1.05%，香港恆生指數走揚1.00%，韓國綜合指數下跌0.89%；陸股則因國慶假期休市，將於10月8日恢復交易。

📝盤點熱門股：友達、聯電、主動中信台灣收益

今日熱門成交榜前五名僅兩檔ETF收紅。面板股友達(2409)以49.34萬張奪冠，股價回落，前波漲多後遭遇外資短線調節，賣壓出籠帶動大量換手；晶圓代工股聯電(2303)排名第二，股價走弱，宣布籌資18億美元的海外可轉債引發市場對潛在股權稀釋的疑慮，短線調節賣壓推升交易熱度。

ETF方面，第三名主動中信台灣收益(00406A)小幅走揚，第四名群益臺灣加權正2(00685L)同步收紅，第五名主動統一升級50(00403A)則小跌；台股在5萬點關前反覆震盪，ETF買賣仍熱絡，主動式與槓桿型產品均躋身成交榜前列。

📌三大法人買賣超

三大法人今日合計賣超207.87億元，其中，投信賣超158.51億元，為法人調節主力；外資同步賣超66.57億元，自營商則合計買超17.21億元。整體來看，外資與投信站在賣方，自營商雖逆勢買超，仍未抵銷兩者賣壓，法人籌碼偏向調節。

✨本日議題股：光電概念股

news.Title: 美國期中選舉歷史規律：歷年選後美股強勁上漲
news.Content:
儘管市場面臨政治與經濟的不確定性，歷史數據顯示美股在期中選舉後通常表現優異。

根據 Truist 首席策略師 Keith Lerner 的分析，自 1946 年以來，每一次期中選舉年之後的一年中，美股皆錄得正報酬。其中，選後一年最大漲幅發生在 1954 年（達 34%），而選後一年的平均漲幅則高達 14.4%。

從季節性趨勢來看，自 1950 年以來，標普 500 指數在期中選舉年的第四季平均上漲 6.6%，且上漲機率高達 84%。此外，強勁的企業獲利也為股市提供實質支撐。

FactSet 數據指出，標普 500 指數第三季預計盈餘年增率達 29.5%，這將是連續第八季實現雙位數成長。華爾街分析師更預期全年盈餘年增率將達到 32.4%。

雖然近期市場面臨油氣價格走高打壓消費者信心，以及債券殖利率上升推升資金成本等逆風，摩根士丹利策略團隊認為，季節性利多自 10 月起將逐漸顯現。綜合而言，歷史規律與企業獲利基本面均為選後股市提供積極支撐。

news.Title: 台股快5萬點58萬人笑不出來　「這檔」慘被再砍8.7萬張　兇手曝光了
news.Content:
台股今（6）日呈現「衝高回落、高檔震盪」的劇烈洗盤格局。受前一日美股走揚加持，加權指數早盤強勢跳空開高，盤中一度大漲超過250點至49,968.92點，距離5萬點大關僅一步之遙。然而，逢高獲利結利賣壓隨即湧現，多頭攻勢受阻，指數急轉直下翻黑，最低下探49,479.69點，高低差近500點，顯示市場在歷史高點前的觀望與解套心態十分濃厚。

隨後盤面靠著台積電等權值股穩健撐盤，配合部分AI供應鏈與題材股強勢輪動，大網逐步收復失地。終場加權指數上漲110.51點，以49,822.55點作收，成功守住紅盤。整體來看，今日台股在叩關5萬點大關時展現出「近關情怯」的猶豫，但下檔買盤支撐力道依然強勁，維持在大盤高檔整理、題材各自發揮的走勢。

外資今天站賣方，賣超66.57億元，同時再對友達下狠手，再砍87,053張，受此影響，友達股價今天開高走低收黑，開盤價在39.25元，最高觸及39.50元，最低下探37.15元，成交價落在37.45元，下跌1.60元，跌幅4.10%。友達股價已經連續兩天下跌，兩天內跌幅達7.42%。

news.Title: 聯電發債18億美元ADR挫8.9% 台股再添賣壓
news.Content:
[ 非凡新聞 ]記者黃靖棻,攝影張皓普

聯電宣布啟動籌資計畫，發行兩筆零息海外可轉換公司債，合計規模18億美元，將更多資源轉向矽光子、先進封裝與12奈米，不過消息卻拖累聯電ADR，周一晚間重挫8.95%，而台積電則是受到可能參與馬斯克晶圓廠合作消息，激勵台積電ADR強彈2.75%，寫下歷史新高。

高效能、低功耗的小晶片面積，由12奈米FinFET製程平台打造，將應用在通訊基礎建設、網通及其他高成長市場。聯電積極開發技術的同時，也正式宣布計畫發行兩筆零息海外可轉換公司債，合計規模18億美元，用於機器設備採購與廠房建設。專家認為，是為了切入高速傳輸以及 AI伺服器核心供應鏈，所做的提前布局。

台經院產經資料庫總監 劉佩真：「它的戰略核心主要是在於，將資源從成熟製程的產能擴張，精準的轉向高附加價值的特殊製程，還有次世代的AI基礎設施。布局12奈米不僅能夠跟英特爾等國際大廠建立深厚的跨國代工合作，更能夠以相對比較低的成本，來承接跨世代特殊製程商機。」

隨著聯電今年已上調至20億美元的資本支出，預計將更多資源轉向矽光子、先進封裝與12奈米，從傳統的產能規模戰轉型到高利基、高護城河，技術方面的防禦策略，企圖在AI戰局中奠定不可替代性。不過，消息卻拖累聯電ADR周一晚間應聲大跌8.95%。

另一方面，台積電ADR則是上漲2.75%，收在485.8美元，創新高。

資深分析師 翁偉捷：「馬斯克或者是川普，其實先後都傳出在德州廠這邊，台積電要加碼（共計）2650億美元，在這邊做蓋廠，主要要跟他們的SpaceX相關集團的公司來做合作，推升了整個市場上對於未來台積電跟馬斯克合作的想像空間，讓ADR價格創下歷史新高紀錄。」

隨著2奈米製程晶片客戶追加訂單，市場對於台積電下周法說會內容具備正面的期待與樂觀預期，因此台積電股價也相對強勢。不過分析師指出，儘管馬斯克證實與台積電進行Terafab晶片製造計畫洽談，但合作尚未定案，短期內需保守看待。（記者黃靖棻、張皓普／台北採訪報導）

news.Title: 《韓股》權值股走弱 KOSPI收跌0.89%
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-06 16:33:59 數位內容中心 發佈

韓股今(6)日走勢分歧，韓國KOSPI指數收於6,941.39點，下跌62.35點或0.89%；韓國KOSDAQ指數收於919.92點，上漲26.63點或2.98%。早盤先受到海外科技股走強帶動開高，但隨後因科技權值回檔與美債殖利率仍處高檔之壓力而轉弱，KOSPI終場由紅翻黑。

此外，KOSPI指數承壓的主因仍在外部利率環境，市場持續擔憂美國長天期公債殖利率維持高檔，削弱風險資產吸引力。投資人同時在等待第三季企業財報與新的政策催化，短線氣氛偏向觀望。

半導體權值股方面，Samsung Electronics(005930.KS)、SK hynix(000660.KS)均收跌，拖累KOSPI指數表現。雖然美國科技股偏強、那斯達克綜合指數收盤創高，帶動韓股早盤情緒，但半導體權值股未能延續漲勢，反而成為指數回檔的關鍵。市場接下來也聚焦Samsung Electronics於10月8日公布的第三季初步業績。

類股方面，在KOSPI承壓之際，部分電池與零組件個股逆勢走高。Samsung SDI(006400.KS)、LG Energy Solution(373220.KS)與Samsung Electro-Mechanics(009150.KS)表現偏強，LG Electronics(066570.KS)則因取得北美資料中心冷卻設備長約而大漲。這顯示資金並未全面撤離，而是轉向具個別題材與利多支撐的個股。

news.Title: 台積電可配置到25%！玉山金首檔主動台股ETF 11/11正式掛牌上市
news.Content:
台股主動式ETF再添新兵！玉山投信今（6）日推出旗下首檔台股主動式ETF，玉山臺灣關鍵科技主動式ETF（00413A），基金經理人郭明玉表示，台積電最高可配置至25%，但初期不會配滿，目前朝前五大持股方向規畫，實際比重將視進場時點決定，預計11月11日正式掛牌交易。

玉山投信董事長張綸宇表示，ETF近年已成為台灣資產管理市場的重要成長引擎，此次推出首檔主動式ETF，也是玉山投信產品布局的重要里程碑。總經理梅以德指出，玉山投信投入台股基金超過30年，長期服務對象涵蓋共同基金、政府基金、壽險及大型機構法人，此次將相關研究與選股經驗延伸至主動式ETF。

00413A基金經理人郭明玉表示，目前AI產業商機已從晶片、伺服器，逐步擴散至光通訊、高速傳輸及測試設備等領域，產業輪動機會持續浮現；不過市場仍有美國利率政策、選舉及地緣政治等變數，基金將透過主動選股方式因應市場及產業變化。

郭明玉指出，以台積電配置來看，依現行規範，一般單一個股持股上限為10%，台積電則適用放寬規定，最高可配置至25%；不過基金成立初期不會直接配滿上限，以免排擠其他個股，目前規畫台積電朝前五大持股方向布局，實際比重仍會依進場時點評估。

00413A預計於10月19日至23日正式募集，於11月11日掛牌交易。玉山投信表示，這檔ETF將透過主動選股方式，鎖定台灣科技供應鏈中具關鍵地位的企業，從AI算力一路布局至終端應用。

產業配置方面，00413A預計涵蓋半導體、電子零組件、通信網路，以及電腦與周邊設備等四大關鍵領域，並從各次產業中篩選具產業核心價值、技術門檻、稀缺資產及戰略地位的企業，掌握AI產業不同階段的受惠族群，包括電力設備、基礎建設，以及具產業升級機會的傳統產業，航太、醫療保健等也納入評估範圍。

配息方面，00413A採季配息機制，基金成立滿180日後，預計每年於1月、4月、7月及10月底進行收益分配評價，實際配息與否及金額仍依基金收益分配規定辦理。

news.Title: 《日股》AI與半導體領漲 日經重返7萬點
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-06 16:24:24 數位內容中心 發佈

日股今(6)日延續漲勢，日經225指數重返7萬點大關、收於70,683.98點，上漲737.12點或1.05%；東證股價指數(TOPIX)收於4,183.56點，上漲38.34點或0.92%。盤面主軸仍是AI與半導體權值股，加上日圓走弱與原油價格回檔，帶動買盤向外擴散，指數順利站上更高區間。

外部環境方面，美股延續強勢，帶動日股開盤後買氣回流。市場對利率上行疑慮降溫，資金先集中在大型電子與半導體相關個股，推升日經225指數重返7萬點上方，成為今日盤面最明確的多頭訊號。

匯率與能源方面，美元兌日圓升至158日圓附近，日圓走弱對汽車等出口相關族群形成支撐，也強化市場風險偏好。另一方面，原油價格回檔讓成本壓力緩解的預期升溫，成為資金追價的另一個因素。

類股方面，非鐵金屬、精密機器、銀行、保險與鐵鋼表現領先，顯示資金不只停留在少數科技龍頭。相較之下，資訊與通訊、建設、空運走弱，反映市場雖偏多，但仍有部分類股承受獲利了結壓力。

權值股方面，愛德萬測試(6857.JP)、TDK(6762.JP)、Fast Retailing(9983.JP)、Fujikura(5803.JP)、Recruit Holdings(6098.JP)、東京威力科創(8035.JP)等成為撐盤主力，其中愛德萬測試對日經225指數的貢獻最為明顯。

news.Title: 亞幣遇壓、台股震盪，新台幣兌美元拉尾小升0.7分，收31.781元
news.Content:
【財訊快報／劉敏夫】台北外匯市場週二新台幣兌美元匯價走升，美國人工智能(AI)相關大型科技股週一大漲，雖激勵台股週二跳空開高，但大盤面臨5萬點大關前獲利及換手賣壓，外資賣超上市股票66.5億元終結連四買，加權指數終場小漲0.22%，台幣由升轉貶震盪後拉尾小升，主要亞幣則呈漲跌互現，市場關注美債殖利率與美元走勢。新台幣兌美元匯率週二以31.781元作收，與前一交易日比較，台幣匯率微幅升值0.7分。銀行間新台幣兌美元最高成交價為31.699元，最低成交價為31.823元，成交量為16億400萬美元。

華僑銀行外匯策略分析師Christopher Wong等人在報告中稱，外資若能持續買超可能為台幣提供支撐，特別是一旦美國經濟數據轉弱，最終帶動美債殖利率及美元整體走低。

不過，在美元仍偏強、外部逆風持續之際，台幣升值步伐可能仍較為漸進，而非大幅加速，美元兌台幣下一道支撐位在31.71至31.73。

news.Title: 全球再迎升息考驗！ 國泰林啟超：台灣經濟成長率上看12%
news.Content:
進入2026年第4季，全球市場一方面面臨油價、通膨及升息壓力，另一方面AI產業基本面仍展現強勁成長動能。國泰投信表示，第4季全球投資環境將呈現「總經有逆風、產業有亮點」景況，美歐日央行仍有升息壓力，美國10年期公債殖利率可能維持高檔，資金成本上升恐加大股市震盪，然而，AI資本支出持續擴張，企業獲利成長仍為科技股提供基本面支撐。台股受惠全球AI供應鏈需求及出口暢旺，美股則由大型科技及半導體企業引領獲利成長，第4季持續關注具實質獲利支撐的科技產業，投資布局以「台美科技雙主線」掌握AI長線成長趨勢。

國泰資產管理暨國泰世華銀行首席經濟學家林啟超表示，戰事推升油價並重新點燃全球通膨疑慮，美國、歐洲及日本央行第4季持續升息機率仍高；目前債市利率亦已逐步反映未來一年約3碼的升息預期，預估至年底美國10年期公債殖利率偏向5%高檔震盪，美元指數則在100上下，油價將是後續重要驅動因素。 展望全年，林啟超預估，台灣出口挑戰9,000億美元，全(2026)年經濟成長率上看12%。

AI獲利成長領跑美股　00830啟動分割案降低投資門檻

國泰費城半導體經理人李翰林分析指出，美股主要指數之一的費城半導體指數，今(2026)明(2027)兩年的EPS成長率分別達到143.7%及45.8%，高於那斯達克100指數及標普500指數；同時，費半指數主要成分股的估值相較2022年11月底ChatGPT問世時已大幅降低，主要來自預期EPS成長率大幅提高，顯示產業仍有獲利成長支撐。

AI產業「大者恆大」　科技龍頭掌握下一波成長紅利

國泰投信產品策略發展處協理游日傑表示，長線上AI發展仍是台股重要投資主線，隨著AI模型規模及應用範圍持續擴張，從GPU、先進製程、先進封裝、高速傳輸，到雲端資料中心與終端應用，所需資本支出與技術門檻同步墊高，半導體及科技版塊「大者恆大」趨勢更加鮮明，具備技術領先、規模經濟及完整客戶基礎的產業龍頭，更有機會承接AI浪潮帶來的龐大商機。

news.Title: 台股都快破五萬 聯電為何被砸盤？專家：關鍵在套利
news.Content:
當台股指數一路衝高之際，聯電股價卻連兩天挨砸吞黑K，讓不少投資人恐慌認賠。分析師周代運指出，市場將下跌歸咎於18億美元海外可轉債引發的稀釋效應，但這僅是表面藉口；真正的關鍵在於避險基金的「套利盤」現股放空賣壓，長線基本面並未轉弱，投資人切莫被短期技術性賣壓洗出場。

市場恐慌稀釋效應

台股走勢強勁，半導體族群多數維持高檔，聯電卻逆勢出現連續兩根黑K往下打。市場聲音一面倒，將回檔原因歸罪於這次發行的18億美元ECB海外可轉債。許多散戶投資人一聽到「股權稀釋」四個字便心生恐慌，盤中選擇認賠殺出，但這其實只是表面的發酵藉口，並非這波股價下挫的核心主因。

籌碼賣壓源自套利

分析師周代運表示：「拿到ECB的避險基金會做delta中性，講白話一點，就是拿到可轉債之後，在現股放空做避險鎖利。這兩天砸出來的賣壓很大一部分就是這批避險空單，屬於短期技術性賣壓，不是法人集體看壞聯電長線營運。」周代運進一步分析，這次ECB轉換價擁有32.5%的溢價，即使未來全數轉換，對股權的稀釋幅度僅約2.34%，比例並不沉重。加上此為零息債，短期無須動用營業現金支付利息，募集到的資金將全數投入晶圓廠設備採購、擴充新加坡廠與台灣成熟製程產能，目標鎖定AI功率IC、MCU及感測器等長線訂單。

此外，目前大盤資金輪動極快，指數主要由少數大權值股拉升，不少標的呈現「賺指數不賺個股」的現象。聯電先前累積了不小漲幅，ECB消息釋出剛好提供法人獲利了結的契機，套利賣壓與獲利賣壓兩相疊加，才導致股價走出逆盤回檔。

成熟製程基本面穩健

從營運數據來看，聯電基本面並未轉弱。第二季EPS達3.39元，毛利率維持在32.5%；官方給出的第三季營運指引顯示，晶圓出貨量預計呈高個位數成長，產能利用率可站上90%以上，毛利率維持在30%中段水準。當前8吋成熟製程需求暢旺，功率IC與電源管理晶片持續拉抬，55nm以上訂單呈現滿載狀態。市場調研機構TrendForce亦預估，成熟代工的漲價行情有機會一路延續至2027年。周代運認為，這次發行ECB的本質，是趁半導體景氣回溫與市場資金寬鬆之際，以低成本取得資金進行擴產卡位，為未來營收鋪路，絕非公司缺錢救急。

長線回歸營運本質

周代運提醒，在套利單尚未完全消化前，短期股價免不了反覆磨人與震盪，容易洗掉信心不足的籌碼。然而，這波回檔屬於資金與套利盤造成的短期擾動，並未打破聯電的營運邏輯，成熟製程、AI邊緣裝置與功率半導體的長線需求依據仍在。周代運強調：「股價短期是投票機，長期才是體重機。消息面可以砸股價一兩天，但是訂單與毛利率，才撐得起長線的股價。」散戶最常踩的陷阱就是將短線消息面賣壓誤認為長線基本面轉空，盲目跟風砍單，反而剛好被洗在套利盤出貨的相對低點。

news.Title: 蘇姿丰：AMD將再擴大投資台灣 產能規劃已拉長至3至5年
news.Content:
超微(AMD-US)董事長暨執行長蘇姿丰今(6)日訪台表示，AMD先前宣布投入台灣供應鏈的100億美元投資，目前進度符合計畫，隨著CPU、GPU及AI需求持續增加，預計將進一步加碼台灣；同時，由於目前CPU需求仍高於供給，公司預計2027年大幅增加供應，與主要供應鏈夥伴的產能規畫也已從過去1至2年，一口氣拉長至3至5年。

蘇姿丰指出，2026年CPU市場大幅成長，AMD今年雖持續增加產品供應及產能，但目前需求仍高於供給，尚無法完全滿足市場，因此正與台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)、後段封裝及載板等供應鏈夥伴共同提高產能。

她進一步表示，AMD今年已逐步增加供應，明年則將進一步「大幅增加」，此次訪台的重要目的之一，就是與主要合作夥伴討論未來產能配置，確保CPU、GPU及AI產品所需的晶圓製造、封裝與其他供應環節都能同步擴充。

隨著需求能見度拉長，AMD與供應商之間的合作模式也出現轉變。過去產能規畫通常以未來1至2年為主，如今已拉長至3至5年，原因正是未來數年運算需求持續強勁，因此必須更早與晶圓代工、後段封裝及其他合作夥伴共同規畫產能。

至於AMD是否可能直接投資晶圓廠，蘇姿丰表示，公司仍會維持目前的商業模式，透過與大型供應商合作取得產能，包括晶圓製造、後段產能及其他供應環節，重點仍是強化與供應鏈的長期共同規畫。

記憶體供應也是AMD目前高度關注的環節。蘇姿丰指出，整體記憶體市場目前仍相當吃緊，AMD正與各家記憶體供應商及客戶共同規畫，確保AI伺服器所需的高頻寬記憶體(HBM)，以及CPU與PC所需的相關記憶體供應。

在先進製程方面，蘇姿丰認為，未來數年仍需要更多先進晶圓產能，她也感謝台積電持續增加產能，並肯定台積電亞利桑那廠目前對AMD的供應表現，期待未來全球更多產能陸續到位。針對市場關注台積電2奈米產能吃緊，蘇姿丰表示，AMD最新CPU產品Venice在大型雲端服務業者以及雲端、企業客戶端的採用率相當高，憑藉AMD與台積電之間緊密的合作關係，公司有信心取得所需產能、滿足市場需求。

除晶圓製造外，先進封裝同樣是AMD擴大AI與高效能運算供應的重要環節。蘇姿丰表示，CoWoS及其他先進封裝技術對高效能運算愈來愈關鍵，AMD持續尋找封裝創新與增加產能的方法，也將深化與台積電在先進封裝領域的合作。

另一方面，AMD最新AI系統Helios已按照原定計畫在第三季開始出貨。目前市場對更多運算能力的需求仍十分強勁，Helios供應正持續爬坡，預計未來數季都將進一步放量。

蘇姿丰此次來台行程緊湊，一天內密集拜會台灣主要客戶與供應鏈夥伴，包括宏碁(2353-TW)、華碩(2357-TW)、鴻海(2317-TW)及廣達(2382-TW)，並與鴻海(2317-TW)董事長劉揚偉交流，下午則預計前往新竹拜會台積電等合作夥伴。

她強調，市場及技術變化速度相當快，因此AMD更需要與主要供應商及合作夥伴保持緊密合作；雖然公司鼓勵供應鏈進行地理多元布局，以提升供應彈性，但台灣對全球半導體供應鏈以及AMD而言，仍是極為重要的一環。

在AI發展方面，蘇姿丰也看好AI代理、個人AI等新型態應用，並認為未來AI不會只有單一贏家。隨著企業、科研、實體AI等不同場景快速發展，各領域都會需要不同形式的AI能力，也將帶動多元運算需求。

她同時強調，AI快速創新與安全並非二選一，產業應讓新技術快速落地，同時建立安全環境，透過企業之間彼此學習及生態系合作，降低AI可能帶來的負面影響。

news.Title: 台積電狂飆天價卻有苦惱！外媒曝「甜蜜炸彈」成新考驗
news.Content:
台積電今（6）日股價早盤一度衝上2590元，市值攀至67.16兆元。外媒指出，蘋果、輝達、超微、高通及聯發科等主要客戶，已將台積電2奈米製程訂單增加約10%至20%，在人工智慧（AI）需求持續升溫之下，尖端製程產能幾乎成為「搶手貨」，但問題也因此浮現，台積電現在缺的不是訂單，而是產能。

市場預期蘋果、輝達等大客戶未來幾年仍將讓台積電先進製程維持高檔利用率，迫使台積電加快2奈米擴產腳步。根據EE Times報導，台積電到2026年底每月2奈米晶圓產能可能達到約12萬片，高於先前預估的9萬至10萬片。

台積電今年將投產5座2奈米晶圓廠，其中2座位於新竹、3座位於高雄，公司也預期，2奈米量產第一年的產量將比3奈米高出45%，2026年至2028年間產能年增幅可能達70%左右。

然而，擴產並非沒有代價。台積電董事長魏哲家已將2026年資本支出計畫上調至600億至640億美元，摩根大通分析師更警告，長期供應不足可能導致部分訂單無法轉化為實際營收，甚至讓客戶尋找三星或英特爾等替代供應商。

此外，2奈米量產初期也將壓縮獲利，台積電預估，2026年下半年2奈米量產可能使毛利率下降約3至4個百分點，海外晶圓廠擴張初期，也可能帶來額外的毛利率壓力。台積電甚至計畫在2027年調高晶圓代工價格約10%，藉此抵銷材料、設備及海外製造成本上升。

台積電預計10月15日公布第三季財報，市場接下來真正關注的，已不只是AI需求有多強，而是台積電能否在瘋狂擴產的同時，守住獲利能力與長期競爭優勢。

華爾街仍持續看好台積電，包括摩根大通維持「買入」評級，並將目標價上調至3300元。高盛也將台積電12個月目標價從3100元上調至3300元，代表還有大約28%的上漲空間。

news.Title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures climb after record-breaking rally
news.Content:
US stock futures continued to march higher as a global bond sell-off and soaring diesel costs haven't dented investors' optimism over upcoming earnings and the artificial intelligence boom.

Contracts for the Nasdaq-100 ( NQ=F ) rose by 0.1% after the Nasdaq Composite ( ^IXIC ) reached a fresh record high , bolstered by all-time highs in Nvidia shares ( NVDA ) and other tech names.

Futures on the Dow Jones Industrial Average ( YM=F ) rose 0.1%, while those on the S&P 500 ( ES=F ) climbed above the flat line. The S&P 500 ( ^GSPC ) is less than 1% away from its record high.

Rising bond yields continue to play a key role, with the 10-year yield ( ^TNX ) sitting at 5.31%, its highest closing level in 24 years. The 30-year yield ( ^TYX ) at 5.66% is also at its highest since 2002.

Tech stocks also caught a bid on Monday after Taiwanese Nvidia partner Foxconn ( 2354.TW ) reported healthy earnings , signaling strong demand globally for AI infrastructure. We're watching Nvidia shares as the company's market capitalization nears $6 trillion.

On Tuesday, Constellation Brands ( STZ ) and Lamb Weston Holdings ( LW ) report earnings, while the economic calendar remains quiet.

LIVE 1 update

1 hr ago Grace O'Donnell

Oil prices slip as traders weigh strong Mideast exports against Gulf tensions

Reuters reports:

news.Title: The Overlooked AI Stock Poised to Outperform Nvidia and Palantir
news.Content:
Nvidia 's (NASDAQ: NVDA) graphics processing units (GPUs) have become the foundational AI hardware for data centers, while Palantir has been one of the strongest purveyors of artificial intelligence software as a service. However, as investments with potential to grow from here, both companies may pale in comparison to liquid cooling specialist Vertiv (NYSE: VRT).

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 14x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

Liquid cooling has become a requirement for AI infrastructure

Liquid cooling has become essential to AI data centers.

Cutting-edge AI chips and infrastructure generate enormous amounts of heat when they operate, and fans and air conditioners can't cool them quickly enough. Without liquid cooling systems of the type that Vertiv provides, the chips can reach temperatures that slow their processing significantly, reduce their lifespans, or even render them unusable.

Because of this, the technology that Vertiv sells has become just as important for the AI build-out as the processors it protects. This positioning translated into 24% year-over-year revenue growth in the second quarter, and management's full-year guidance is for 31% revenue growth, implying that growth will accelerate.

Vertiv's operating profits jumped 44% year over year to $638 million in Q2, indicating a sustainable business model. CEO Giordano Albertazzi expressed confidence that the company could maintain its strong performances in 2026 and beyond as AI demand heats up.

A leading competitive positioning comes with a reasonable price tag

Vertiv has established itself as the clear leader in liquid cooling for AI data centers. While other companies also offer this service, Vertiv has gone all-in with this technology, and it has inked a partnership with Nvidia. Vertiv's 800 VDC power portfolio, specifically designed to support the Rubin Ultra platform that Nvidia will roll out in 2027, is expected to come out by the end of the year. Companies looking to use the latest Nvidia technology will need to upgrade their Vertiv infrastructure components.

Management mentioned in Vertiv's Q2 presentation that the company has a strong backlog for the second half, and pipeline momentum points to another strong year overall. While the North American region is still hot, Vertiv is also expanding across the Asia Pacific region to pursue additional growth opportunities.

Story Continues

This investment thesis comes with an attractive valuation for patient shareholders. Vertiv trades at a 1-year forward P/E ratio of 28, down from a peak of 41 this summer after a prolonged correction. The stock also trades at a five-year PEG ratio of 0.84; a positive PEG ratio below 1 is typically viewed as indicating that a stock is undervalued.

Vertiv's growth engine doesn't appear likely to slow down anytime soon. With long-term catalysts for the liquid cooling market, its valuation should improve over time.
